race.title: Home Is Where The Heart Is Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: Preference is for RAFFLES WONDER who is potentially well handicapped back over hurdles making only his second start for his new yard. He gets the vote ahead of the lightly-raced Le Fabuleux Buck's on his stable debut, with Bruce Banner and Bollin Skittle completing the shortlist. RAFFLES WONDER (FR) LE FABULEUX BUCK'S (FR) BRUCE BANNER (IRE)
